name: Supernova Remnant
desc: The delicate expanding wreck of an exploded star — nested shock shells of gas ballooning outward as filaments of red hydrogen and cyan oxygen wisp and braid along the blast front, forever re-igniting new shells at the core so the remnant never stops growing.

style.doc: red+cyan Veil vs teal OIII vs hot Chandra vs monochrome etched
